I found the code in the first-layer biases `b1`. I worked this out by reading the weights only, without running anything.

1. **The first four biases are odd.** `b1[0..3]` = 0.11, 0.23, 0.07, 0.12. Every other value in the network has three decimal places, but these have only two. Read as whole numbers they are 11, 23, 7, 12. Taking those as positions in the alphabet (A=1) gives **K W G L**.
2. **The last four biases repeat the code.** `b1[28..31]` = 0.075, 0.087, 0.071, 0.076. Read as whole numbers they are 75, 87, 71, 76, which are the ASCII codes for **K W G L**.

The same word comes out of two separate places using two different encodings, so this is very unlikely to be chance. Biases this small barely change which move the network plays, which is probably why they were used to hide the code.

CODE: KWGL
